definitions.full: H6792. tsoneh or tsone צֹנֶה , [ צֹנֶא ] noun [masculine] flocks (|| form of צאֹן q. v.); — absolute צֹנֶה Psa 8:8 ; suffix צֹנַאֲכֶם Num 32:24 (JE).
